book.name: Maliki
book.title: N'halo ghwa maha handa paghutyekwite na MALIKI

content: Yesu kangunlamiha mundu yuna ulelebhalo ghwa kibhoko
Yesu kakiyingila kangi mu kitutubhi kya kukonganila Akaayahudi, na akwo pakibha na mundu yumo yunaulelebhaho ghwa kibhoko.
Amwo, amoo bhandu bhangi bhakintyegha kanlamihe mundu ayo lisiku lya kupughwa apati ngupukiho ya kuntakila.
Yesu kakinng'ombela mundu yula ywakalelebhukite kibhoko, “Ghuhike apa paulongolo”
Mbole kakiakonya bhandu, “Hinu lyoki likunoghelwa kutendwa mu lisiku lya kupughwa, kutenda mihalo ya maha ebu mahakataho, kulopoha ubhumi ebu kukoma?” Peni bhombe akinyamala jii.
Yesu kakialolekeha bhoha kwa kiyaghabhu, na kakikukulika kwa hyeta ya myoyo yabhe, na kakinng'ombela yula mundu, “Ghugholohe kibhoko kyako!” Kakikigholoha kibhoko kyake na kikibha kya maha kangi.
Kamu Akaafalisayo bhakighenda panji kutenda ngokeho pamoo na bhandu bha kimati kya Helode bhakipalaha njila ya kunkanjaghana Yesu.
Lumati lwa bhandu mubwegha ya lihibha
Yesu kakibhuka papamu na ahundwa bhake kakighenda kumbwegha ya lihibha Galilaya na bhandu ayoloho kuhuma kunnima ghwa Galilaya,
ku Idumea kumwambo ya lukemba Yoludani, kiyaha bhakiyihwa mihalo miyoloho yakatendite,
Kiyaha ya kya lumati lukulu lwa bhandu Yesu kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake, bhanyeghele bhwato atame amwo ngati lumati lwa bhandu lukotoke kunnyuka.
Kiyaha Kakialamiha atamwa bha mahele, ndo bhala bhana utamwa bhakiyukana ngati anbyale.
Bhandu bha abheghite na mandilo paanmonite Yesu bhakilitagha pahi pa ulongolo ghwa maghulu ghake na bhakikyota kyobho, “Ghwenga ndo Mwana ghwa Chapanga.”
Peni Yesu kakiakwilikiha ghala mandilu kwa lilakali bhakotoke kummanyiha kwa bhandu.
Yesu kanguahaghula Andumitumi mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili
Yesu kakihubhuka kukitumbi, kakiakema bhala abhahaghulite nabho bhakighenda naywo.
Kakiahaghula mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili ndo abha akiakema Andumitumi, ngati abheghe papamu na ywombe, kakaalaghihe kulandamiha
kangi abheghe na makakala gha kughabhinga bhinga mandilu.
Abha ndo bhala mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili akabhahaghuliti, Simoni ywene Yesu kakinpegha lihina lya Petili,
Yakobu na Yohani bhana bha Zebedayu, bhombe kakibhapegha lihina Boanelege, mana yake ndo bhana bha lulundumo,
Andelea na Filipi na Batolomayo na Matayo na Tomasi na Yakobu mwana ghwa Alufayo na Tadayo na Simoni Nkananayu na
Yuda Isikaliyoti, ywene ywakankilukite Yesu.
Yesu na Belisebuli
Mbole Yesu kakibhuya ukaya, lumati lwa bhandu lukikwemuka kangi, mbaka mwene na ahundwa bhake bhakilepelwa kulyegha hilyo.
Paayihwite alongo bhake mihalo ayi bhakighenda kuntola, mana bhandu bhakighomba, “Kayingilwa na nng'uluka.”
Ahunda bha malaghilo bhakihika kuhuma ku Yelusalemu, bhakighomba, “Ayu kana Belisebuli! Kangi kangubhabhinga bhinga mandilo kwa makakala gha nkulu ghwa mandilo.”
Hinu Yesu kakibhakema bhombe na kubhaghombela kwa mihwanu, “Nchipila katahotola bhuli kunbhinga bhinga Nchipila nnyake?
Handa ghubhutwa ghumo ghumegheka mulumati hinakupingikana, ghubhutwa agwo ghwalama ng'obhe.
Na handa lubhagha lumo lutamegheka mulumati lumati lunakupingikana, lubhagha alwo lutatengeleheka ng'obhe.
Na handa ghubhutwa ghwa nchipila ghutapwilinganika mu himati hichoko hichoko kabhone kuhotola na uhiko ghwake ghuhika.”
“Kabhone mundu ywohele yula ywakahotola kuyingila kukitutubhi kya mundu yuna makakala na kunpoka utopelo ghwake, mbaka kakantute na kammope mundu aywo, ndo katahotola kunpoka utopelo ghwake.”
“Kulyaghila nungubhaghombela gha hoto bhandu bhatalekekehwa ulemwa ghwabhe ghwoha na ngundulo hyabhe hyoha kwa Chapanga.
Peni yunakunkundula Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kabhone kulekekehwa, kana nongwa ya ulemwa ghwa masiku ghoha.”
Yesu kakighomba habhu kiyaha bhombe bhakighomba, “Kana lindilo.”
Ma na alongo bhake Yesu.
Ma ghwake Yesu na alongo bhake bhakihika papamu na bhakiyima panji, bhakinlaghila mundu kankeme.
Lumati lwa bhandu lukibha palukintindila. Ndo, bhandu bhakinng'ombela, “Ma ghwako na alongo bhako bhabhegha panji, bhangukukema.”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Ma ghwangu na alongo bhangu ndo a ghani?”
Apa kakialolekeha bhala bhandu bhaantindilite, na kakighomba, “Abha ndo ma ghwangu na ndo alongo bhangu.
Mundu ywohele ywakatenda ghakaghapala Chapanga, aywo ndo nlongo ghwangu na nhacha ghwangu na ndo ma ghwangu.”
